method: Per room: the operator or marketplace gallery was checked first and is never republished without a stated licence; where no licence exists, a Wikimedia Commons file is used only when its title and description identify the room's building. A brand's other properties are not substitutes: an image is cleared only for the building at the venue's own address. Every room without a cleared asset keeps a withheld record, and any asset withdrawn after a check is kept under `withdrawn` with its reason.
